start_rule: first SSE or SZSE open session after this protocol is merged; roll to next open session when closed
secondary_guards: ST availability using source-bound announcement/publication time
confirmed termination notice after source coverage audit
uncertainty: 95 percent calendar-month block bootstrap interval for primary paired daily return difference
support_rule: primary return difference > 0 and lower 95 percent interval bound > 0; otherwise unsupported or inconclusive; no retuning against this window
interim_visibility: data-quality completeness only; no strategy NAV, return, drawdown or capacity outcome inspection/publication
daily_archive: announcement and ST source evidence/availability time
storage: external project DATA_ROOT, immutable versioned directories; corrections are new versions and retain prior inputs

missing_data_rules.empty_event_table: does not establish complete event coverage
missing_data_rules.unresolved_terminal_mark_or_proceeds: final NAV incomplete; no annual performance publication

prohibitions: no threshold or parameter changes during holdout
no deleting legal shares or inventing disposal cash
known_limitations: does not measure queue priority or own market impact
252 sessions may provide limited statistical power
